memories.author: D05
memories.text: Irritable bowel syndrome, allergic rhinitis, hypothyroidism. Patient reports intermittent abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhoea, nasal congestion, sneezing, fatigue, weight gain. Abdomen soft, mild tenderness in left lower quadrant, no masses. Nasal mucosa pale, turbinates swollen. Vital signs stable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide 2 mg SOS
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray one spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS
levothyroxine 50 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 13.8 g/L (13-17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/L (150-400). Stool routine: no ova, cysts, pus cells. tTG-IgA: negative (<4 U/mL). TSH: 4.8 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4: 12.0 pmol/L (9-21). Total IgE: 210 IU/mL (<100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Skin prick test: positive wheal to house dust mite (3 mm), mixed grasses (2 mm), negative to histamine control and saline. Consistent with allergic rhinitis.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis: seasonal exacerbation with sneezing, clear nasal discharge, nasal congestion; triggered by dust exposure at work. No asthma symptoms.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the mebeverine twice daily and the levothyroxine each morning. My belly feels less crampy but I still get loose stools after spicy food. My nose is still stuffy in the evenings, especially after cleaning the shop.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Follow-up: IBS symptoms improved but occasional diarrhoea persists. Allergic rhinitis better with nasal spray, occasional breakthrough sneezing. Hypothyroidism: TSH still slightly high, fatigue unchanged. Abdomen soft, no tenderness. Nasal mucosa less pale.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH: 3.2 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4: 13.5 pmol/L (9-21). CBC: Hb 14.0 g/L, WBC 5.8 x10^9/L, Plt 205 x10^9/L. Stool routine: normal. Total IgE: 180 IU/mL.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booking: Review appointment with Dr Suresh Menon (D05) on 2026-01-15 at 10:30 AM for chronic disease follow‑up.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Review: IBS stable, no alarm symptoms. Allergic rhinitis well controlled on current regimen. Hypothyroidism: TSH within target, patient reports improved energy. No medication side effects noted.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH: 2.9 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4: 13.8 pmol/L (9-21). Total IgE: 165 IU/mL. CBC: Hb 14.2 g/L, WBC 6.0 x10^9/L, Plt 210 x10^9/L.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84 (84%). No significant bronchodilator response. Baseline lung function normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Dr Gita Rao, Gastroenterology, for evaluation of persistent IBS‑type symptoms despite first‑line therapy; consider further investigation for bile acid malabsorption or small bowel bacterial overgrowth.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Gastroenterology review completed. Breath test negative for SIBO. SeHCAT test normal. Advised to continue mebeverine and ispaghula, consider low‑FODMAP diet trial. No further intervention needed.
